items.title: Fix Browser Skill Activation for Seamless User Experience in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves an issue where the Browser Skill was not usable in subsequent messages after being loaded. The fix ensures that the skill remains active and available, preventing the model from incorrectly reporting that tools were never exposed. Comprehensive tests have been added to validate the changes and ensure reliability.

items.title: Enhanced LatentSync Timeout for Smooth Rendering in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the LatentSync rendering timeout in the digitalhuman pipeline, increasing it from a fixed 30 minutes to a configurable 5100 seconds. This change ensures that longer clips can render successfully without being prematurely terminated, while still adhering to GPU watchdog limits. The fix has been validated with successful rendering of a 63-second clip, improving overall performance and reliability.

items.title: Enhance Service Logo Display with Application Emoji in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces application emojis for service logos, allowing them to appear inline in message titles on Discord. Key changes include the addition of new emoji handling functionality and adjustments to message formatting for better readability. The implementation also addresses several bugs related to emoji naming and message caching, ensuring a smoother user experience.

items.title: Enhance Numeric Handling for Workers in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update standardizes the handling of numeric strings in the `ephone` and `bananarouter` workers for the `/seedance/videos` endpoint. By normalizing the `duration` and `seed` parameters, we ensure consistent behavior across all four workers, preventing failures when numeric strings are passed. The changes have been validated and result in no deletions, only additions, enhancing the robustness of the service.

items.title: Enhance MCP Tool Management with Always-Allow Toggles in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new section for MCP tools, allowing users to set per-tool 'always allow' toggles for connected servers. This enhancement improves user experience by enabling pre-approval of tools before first use, reducing repetitive prompts. Additionally, safety measures ensure that tools are properly classified and that permissions are managed effectively.

items.title: Update frames limit to 289 in Clis 🎉
items.summary: The maximum frame count for the seedance CLI has been corrected to align with the OpenAPI specification. The help text for the `--frames` option was updated from '29-361' to '29-289', ensuring accurate user guidance. This change enhances compliance with the defined API constraints.

items.title: Enhance Seedance Video Parameters in M C Ps 🎥
items.summary: This update syncs the Seedance MCP server with the latest OpenAPI specifications. Key changes include lowering the maximum frames from 361 to 289 and relaxing the minimum duration requirement to allow for auto-duration with a value of -1. These adjustments enhance flexibility for video generation across different Seedance models.

items.title: Update audio/video requirements in Backend 🎉
items.summary: This update enhances the documentation by adding specific requirements for audio and video materials in the Seedance feature. Key changes include clarifying the acceptable formats, duration limits, and size restrictions for reference audio and video files. These adjustments aim to prevent user errors and improve the overall experience when creating video generation tasks.

items.title: Align frames limit with official specs in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update corrects the frames limit and applicable models to align with official documentation. The maximum value for frames has been adjusted from 361 to 289, and errors will now be thrown for unsupported models like 2.0 series and 1.5 Pro when frames are used. This change prevents unnecessary failures upstream and ensures a smoother user experience.

items.title: Enhance seek API to handle numeric strings gracefully in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the `seek` worker in the `/seedance/videos` API by normalizing numeric string inputs for the `duration`, `seed`, and `execution_expires_after` parameters. Previously, passing a string for `duration` resulted in a 400 error, leading to inconsistent API behavior across channels. Now, the API will only accept valid decimal strings, ensuring smoother validation and billing processes.

items.title: Fix email encoding issue for non-ASCII sender names in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a bug where non-ASCII sender names were not properly encoded, leading to SMTP 554 rejections. A new function `_encoded_address()` has been introduced to ensure compliance with RFC 2047 for non-ASCII display names while leaving the email address intact. Additionally, two new tests have been added to validate the encoding functionality.

items.title: Fix authority credentials for browser uploads in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves a critical issue where browser sessions failed to upload images due to a missing authority token, resulting in a 503 error. The fix involves injecting the necessary `AUTH_BACKEND_URL` and `AUTH_BACKEND_INTERNAL_TOKEN` into the deployment configuration. Additionally, new tests have been added to ensure the correct environment variables are set, preventing future occurrences of this issue.

items.title: Enhance CI for Appliance Security Tests in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update integrates appliance security tests into the CI pipeline, ensuring that critical checks are performed during the review phase rather than post-merge. The changes include adding `test_deployment_access.py` and `test_appliance_proxy.py` to the testing workflow, which passed successfully. Additionally, a previous misdiagnosis regarding workflow permissions has been clarified, confirming that current settings are adequate.

items.title: Enhance Webhook Management and Invoice Notification Settings in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new webhook management page and enhances the invoice notification settings panel. Users can now manage webhooks with a comprehensive interface, including editing, testing, and deleting options. Additionally, the invoice page has been updated to allow for notification settings directly linked to webhook events, improving user experience and functionality.

items.title: Introducing Configurable Outbound Webhook System in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a versatile webhook configuration layer, allowing superusers to set up HTTP requests for various events, such as invoice creation and cancellation. Key components include the new Webhook and WebhookSubscription models, enabling reusable outbound requests and event bindings. The implementation enhances notification capabilities, ensuring timely alerts for invoice management without manual checks.

items.title: Enhance Tab Grouping for Agent Management in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new feature that groups tabs managed by the agent, providing users with clear visual cues about which tabs belong to the agent. The implementation includes a dedicated color and title for the tab group, enhancing user experience by preventing confusion with personal tabs. Comprehensive testing has been conducted, ensuring all new functionalities are robust and reliable.

items.title: Enhance Browser Binding Token Authentication in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new authentication class that accepts both broad and narrow tokens for browser binding verification. By allowing the use of a narrower relay token, we mitigate the risk of exposing plaintext OAuth and BYOC credentials. The changes have been thoroughly tested, with all new tests passing successfully.

items.title: Enhance Debugger Feedback for User Actions in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves how the extension handles user interactions with the debugger. When a user cancels debugging or switches to DevTools, the system now correctly reports 'debugger_unavailable' instead of 'stale_target', preventing unnecessary command failures. Key changes include persistent tracking of the reason for tab removal and improved handling of concurrent operations.

items.title: Revamp Invoice Details and Application Flow in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update enhances the invoice details display in the admin panel by structuring the information into clear sections, improving usability. It also introduces a selection option for invoice types during the application process, ensuring accurate currency representation and preventing errors. Additionally, internationalization support has been expanded to cover multiple languages, enhancing accessibility for users worldwide.

items.title: Fix invoice currency and type selection for China in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves issues with invoice amounts displayed in CNY for Chinese orders, ensuring they reflect the actual paid amount in RMB. It introduces a new invoice type selection feature, allowing customers to choose between general and special invoices. Additionally, it enhances error handling for currency conversion and includes a new API endpoint for invoice previews.

items.title: Enhance Security for Remote Debugging in Backend 🔒
items.summary: This update introduces a new ops token mechanism for remote debugging, ensuring that tenants cannot access sensitive operations on their Windows VMs. Key changes include the addition of a tenant-specific `WISDOM_OPS_TOKEN`, which is required for executing commands via the `/api/debug/exec` endpoint. The migration also enhances the redaction of privileged keys to prevent unauthorized access, significantly improving the security posture of the platform.

items.title: Strengthened Security for Remote Execution in Wisdom 🔒
items.summary: This update enhances the security of the remote execution endpoint by implementing a dual-token system. The `WISDOM_OPS_TOKEN` is now required for access, ensuring that tenants cannot exploit the endpoint without proper authorization. Additionally, several potential data leaks have been addressed, and new tests have been added to verify security surfaces.

items.title: Enhance API Error Messaging for Key Restrictions in Gateway 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new exception, `ApiNotAllowedException`, to provide clearer error messaging when API keys are restricted to specific endpoints. The previous error message misled users into thinking they needed to apply for service access, while the actual issue was a limitation on the key's allowed APIs. The changes improve user experience by ensuring accurate feedback on API access issues.

items.title: Fix misleading type annotations for numeric setters in Nexior 🔧
items.summary: This update corrects the type annotations for four numeric setters in the Nexior components, changing them from `set(val: string)` to `set(val: number)`. This change enhances type safety and ensures that the components correctly handle numeric values, preventing potential issues during audits and future code modifications. The adjustments have been validated with successful type checks and linting.

items.title: Enhance Parameter Handling for Numeric Inputs in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the handling of numeric parameters in the request body by normalizing string inputs to integers. Key parameters like 'frames', 'duration', and others are now validated to ensure they are treated as numbers, preventing errors during processing and billing. This change enhances the robustness of the service and ensures accurate task execution.

items.title: Fix integer parameter handling in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update resolves an issue where integer parameters were incorrectly sent as strings, causing errors in API requests. Key changes include unified numeric checks, adjustments to input handling, and improved type definitions to ensure integers are processed correctly. The fix enhances overall API interaction reliability and user experience.

items.title: Fix email confirmation dialog issue in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update resolves a critical bug where the email confirmation dialog was obscured by the composer overlay, preventing users from sending emails. By adjusting the z-index using Element Plus's composable, the confirmation dialog now appears correctly above the composer, ensuring that users can interact with it as intended. Comprehensive testing has been conducted to verify the fix.

items.title: Fix read-only file issue for OEM self-heal in Wisdom 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue where the `api-health.ps1` script failed to refresh due to read-only attributes on files in the `C:\OEM` directory. The solution involves clearing the read-only attribute before writing, ensuring that the refresh process works correctly on real devices. Additionally, a new test has been added to replicate the original failure scenario, confirming the fix's effectiveness.

items.title: Revamp API Documentation for Enhanced Clarity in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update focuses on improving the API documentation by removing sensitive implementation details from the appliance specs. Key changes include rewriting descriptions in the OpenAPI files to ensure they are customer-friendly while maintaining the same interface behavior. The documentation now emphasizes user-relevant information without exposing internal processes.

items.title: Enhance User Experience with Channel Probe in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new channel probe that evaluates what users actually see in Discord, addressing limitations of existing API checks. It validates key message elements such as logos, prompts, and mentions, ensuring any discrepancies are flagged for review. The implementation has been successfully tested, confirming zero defects across all services.

items.title: Updated WeWork API Documentation for Clarity in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update refines the WeWork API documentation to remove implementation details while preserving essential semantic information. Key changes include rephrasing descriptions of message retrieval and QR code generation to enhance clarity for users. The behavior and contract of the API remain unchanged, ensuring a seamless experience for developers.

items.title: Revamped API Documentation for Clarity in Wisdom ✨
items.summary: This update refines the API documentation by removing technical jargon and implementation details, ensuring a more user-friendly experience. Key phrases have been reworded to focus on user actions rather than backend processes, while maintaining the same functionality and interface contracts. The changes enhance clarity for end-users without altering the underlying behavior of the API.

items.title: Enhance API Selector with Service Names and Icons in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the API selector on the authorization page by displaying service names and icons, while filtering out private services. Key changes include grouping APIs by service, enhancing search functionality, and ensuring a clearer interface with distinct method and path displays. Additionally, internationalization support has been updated to reflect these changes across multiple languages.

items.title: Enhance API Security and Clarity in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the API by preventing private service endpoints from being listed anonymously, reducing the total visible endpoints from 200 to 151. Additionally, the API now includes service information in the response, allowing for better identification of endpoints. Tests have been added to ensure that private services are correctly filtered out in the list view.

items.title: Fix recipient selection issue in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update resolves a deadlock issue when creating new emails, specifically in the recipient selection step. Users can now select recipients without needing to save a draft first, enhancing the overall email creation experience. The logic has been adjusted to allow audience selection based on rules when no draft exists, streamlining the process.

items.title: Enhance Discord Message Presentation and Add Service Logo in Platform Service 🎨
items.summary: This update refines the message presentation in Discord by tightening line spacing and ensuring prompts match the title's font size. Additionally, it introduces service logos to enhance visual identification, addressing previous issues with logo retrieval for certain services. Key changes include improved error handling and adjustments to ensure all services display correctly.

items.title: Add WeChat Bot Favicon and Enhance Backfill Script in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a favicon for the WeChat automation bot, addressing its absence in the application list. The backfill script has been modified to support Deployment types, ensuring that these services can now have icons sourced from a curated design. Additionally, the script documentation has been updated to reflect these changes.

items.title: Fix task failure handling and recovery in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves issues with the task failure handling in the Aichat2 service, specifically addressing the erroneous permanent shutdown of tasks after consecutive failures. Key changes include removing the state change on business failures, allowing tasks in 'error' state to be revived, and ensuring accurate scheduling upon task recovery. Additionally, new tests have been added to validate these changes and ensure system reliability.

items.title: Enhance Audience Segmentation with Clickable Groups in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces clickable audience segments on the email marketing page, allowing users to view specific members within each segment. By reusing existing components, users can now access a detailed drawer that lists members, complete with pagination and search functionality. The changes ensure a seamless experience while maintaining data integrity and accessibility standards.

items.title: New Audience Rule Candidates API for Email Marketing in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new POST endpoint for retrieving audience candidates based on specific rules without requiring a campaign. The new API maintains consistency with existing data structures and does not alter any current routes or response formats. Performance tests confirm that the new implementation is efficient and does not introduce additional load on the system.

items.title: Integrate Missing Email Audience Tests into CI in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update adds four previously unexecuted email audience test files to the CI pipeline, ensuring that 62 tests are now run during continuous integration. Key issues were identified and resolved, including a persistent failing test due to a missing database table and incorrect assertions. The changes enhance the robustness of the testing framework and prepare for future feature developments.

items.title: Enhance Debugger Detachment Logging in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the logging of debugger detachment reasons, addressing issues where different detachment scenarios appeared identical in the cloud. Key changes include capturing Chrome's detachment reasons and differentiating between user actions and system events. The modifications enhance diagnostic capabilities, ensuring clearer insights into tab management and recovery processes.

items.title: Enhance Result Rejection Logging in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the logging of rejected results in the browser relay and aichat2 components. It now specifies the reasons for rejection, such as authentication issues and state mismatches, while also logging non-completed command statuses. These changes enhance troubleshooting capabilities and reduce ambiguity in error reporting.

items.title: Enhance OEM Self-Heal Mechanism in Wisdom 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new approach to refresh the OEM scripts for existing appliances by leveraging the Wisdom Python package. It addresses a deadlock issue where older devices could not pull in necessary updates due to frozen scripts. The solution ensures that the OEM scripts are always current, significantly improving the self-healing capabilities for legacy tenants.

items.title: Enhance OEM Script Refresh Mechanism in Wisdom 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new mechanism to refresh OEM scripts from the image on every boot, addressing the issue where existing devices could not receive updates to PowerShell scripts. Key changes include the addition of a new script, `load-shared-oem.ps1`, and modifications to the Dockerfile and startup batch file to facilitate this process. This ensures that fixes can reach appliances that were installed before the update, improving overall system reliability.

items.title: Enhance shared image payload support for multiple directories in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update allows the `shared_image_payload` to accept both single and multiple `{source, target}` mappings, enabling the staging of OEM scripts alongside application code. The migration ensures backward compatibility while improving the deployment process. Additionally, safety checks have been implemented to prevent command injection and path escape vulnerabilities.

items.title: Enhance Email Preview and Step Confirmation in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the email preview functionality by correctly displaying the custom sender name instead of a hardcoded value. Additionally, the step confirmation text has been updated to reflect the new process, changing it to 'Confirm and send'. These changes enhance user experience and ensure clarity in the email marketing workflow.

items.title: Align Suno CLI with Latest OpenAPI Specs in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes the Suno CLI request semantics with the latest OpenAPI documentation. Key changes include updating the `suno custom` command to send the correct payload and making `--user-id` mandatory for the `suno personas` command. Additionally, the action help text has been updated to reflect the current action enum, enhancing user experience and consistency.

items.title: Docs sync confirmation for aichat, fish, and suno in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This PR confirms that the OpenAPI contracts for aichat, fish, and suno are aligned with the latest documentation updates. A review of the models, tool inputs, and endpoint paths revealed no discrepancies, and no server code changes were necessary. The updates primarily involved non-contractual message text adjustments.

items.title: Enhance API Authorization Controls in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new feature allowing users to restrict which APIs can be called by authorized parties. A toggle and multi-select option have been added to the authorization form, enabling users to specify allowed APIs while maintaining existing functionalities. Additionally, internationalization support has been improved across multiple languages.

items.title: Cleaned Up Customer-Facing API Documentation in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses 25 instances across 13 specifications to remove upstream references from customer-facing documentation. Key changes include rephrasing error messages and adjusting audio URLs to point to the platform's CDN. The modifications ensure that customers no longer see any supplier-related information, enhancing confidentiality and compliance.

items.title: Enhance API Whitelisting for Credentials in Gateway 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a per-credential API allowlist feature, enabling more granular control over which APIs can be accessed based on the credential used. The implementation ensures that existing credentials remain unrestricted while new ones can specify allowed API IDs, enhancing security without impacting legacy functionality. Additionally, task-polling endpoints are exempt from this restriction to maintain usability.

items.title: Enhance API Authorization with Specific Limits in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new feature allowing API authorization to be restricted to specific API IDs, enhancing security and control. Additionally, it fixes a bug in the editing interface that previously resulted in 405 errors, ensuring users can now update their credentials without issues. The changes maintain backward compatibility for existing credentials while providing a more granular permission model.

items.title: Streamlined Email Sending Process in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update simplifies the email campaign process from five steps to just three: Compose Email, Select Audience, and Send. Key changes include the addition of sender display names and reply-to addresses, as well as improved visibility for unsubscribed or suppressed recipients. The Campaign Detail page has been transformed into a pure status page, enhancing user experience and clarity.

items.title: Streamlined Email Sending Process in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update simplifies the email sending process by consolidating multiple steps into a single action, enhancing efficiency for sending product updates to registered users. Key changes include the introduction of a new `send_campaign()` function, removal of the wave concept, and adjustments to recipient visibility in the UI. The modifications aim to maintain compliance while improving user experience.

items.title: Fix WeChat Deployment Error Messaging in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses misleading error messages during WeChat deployments. The error messaging now clearly indicates when the WeChat service is unavailable while the instance remains healthy, preventing unnecessary redeployments. Additionally, a new retry mechanism for stalled preparations has been implemented, enhancing user experience and reducing confusion.

items.title: Enhance CI with Appliance Domain Guard in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update adds the appliance domain guard test to the CI workflow, ensuring that the old domain does not override the cluster records. By including this test, we enhance the reliability of our CI process without altering the execution environment or introducing new failures. This change addresses a critical gap in our testing coverage, improving overall system security.

items.title: Enhance Retry Mechanism During Preparation in Wisdom 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses two critical issues that caused the system to freeze during the 'preparing' state. The retry mechanism now consistently sets the retry flag, allowing the coordinator to manage retries effectively. Additionally, the preparation process has been transitioned to a background task, ensuring that the system remains responsive and can handle retries without freezing.

items.title: Enhance Agent Health Check to Ensure Device Recovery in Wisdom 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the watchdog to probe the agent's own `/api/status` instead of the gateway's `/api/health`, preventing false positives in device health checks. The change ensures that the agent's status is accurately reported, allowing for proper recovery mechanisms to trigger when needed. Additionally, a previously ineffective assertion in the tests has been corrected to improve reliability.

items.title: Optimize Directory Discovery and Caching in Wisdom 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces significant improvements to the directory discovery process by making full disk scans optional and implementing caching for results. These changes address previous performance bottlenecks, reducing the time spent in the 'preparing data' phase from over 20 minutes to just seconds. Additionally, new tests have been added to ensure the reliability of these enhancements.

items.title: Documenting S1 Completion and Key Changes in Index 🚀
items.summary: This PR documents the completion of S1 with all five steps finalized, totaling 23 merged PRs. Key changes include a shift from dual-end generation to dual-end assertions and a correction regarding the convergence of canonicalization methods, which were found to introduce bugs rather than resolve them. Additionally, important review findings have been addressed to enhance the overall robustness of the implementation.

items.title: Enhance Frame Validation and Signing in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces critical enhancements to the relay-to-device frame validation, ensuring that all frames are now included in parity checks. Additionally, the signing profile assertions have been improved to verify actual byte outputs, preventing potential silent failures. The manifest has also been corrected to avoid requiring outdated fields, enhancing overall system reliability.

items.title: Enhance Relay-to-Device Protocol Description in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update completes the schema for the relay-to-device communication, adding four essential frames: session.start, session.renew, session.stop, and browser.command. It also introduces an enum for the state in browser.result while ensuring that browser.error.state remains flexible. The signing profiles have been aligned across implementations to maintain consistency, and all tests have passed successfully.

items.title: Unify Invoice Access Points to 'View Invoice' in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update consolidates three invoice access points across the platform into a single 'View Invoice' option, enhancing user clarity. The backend now presents invoices in the browser instead of offering downloads, which aligns with the new front-end messaging. Additionally, redundant logic has been streamlined into a shared utility function, improving code maintainability.

items.title: Enhance Invoice Viewing Experience in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the invoice viewing experience by ensuring that invoices are displayed in the browser instead of being forcefully downloaded. The webhook now prioritizes the hosted invoice URL, providing users with a more informative view, while also normalizing existing data. Additionally, the pre-signed URL for the Chinese region has been updated to explicitly allow inline viewing, enhancing usability.

items.title: Exciting gpt-image Integration and Bug Fixes in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the gpt-image generation and editing features, providing a new way for users to create and modify images directly in Discord. Additionally, four critical bugs were identified and resolved during real-world testing, enhancing the overall stability and functionality of the platform. Key improvements include better routing support and clearer error messages for users.

items.title: Audit Fixes for Hardcoded User Messages in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses critical issues with hardcoded user messages in the server-side code, ensuring that notifications are rendered in the user's preferred language. Key changes include the removal of static Chinese text and the implementation of a locale-based fallback system for notifications. Additionally, several other localization issues were identified and documented for future resolution.

items.title: Enhance Scheduled Run Status Display in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces an 'indeterminate' status for scheduled runs, allowing outcomes that cannot be verified to be displayed as '待确认' instead of '失败'. Key changes include updates to the `IScheduledRunStatus` type, localization for 18 languages, and adjustments to the UI to differentiate between statuses. The implementation improves user experience by accurately reflecting the state of scheduled tasks.

items.title: Enhance Aichat2 Outcome Judging and Notification System in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the Aichat2 outcome judging process by addressing issues with goal truncation and misclassification of outcomes. Key changes include the introduction of an 'indeterminate' status, adjustments to how prompts are processed, and enhancements to notification copy for better localization. These modifications aim to reduce false failure rates and improve user experience across different languages.

items.title: Fix pricing page navigation for deployment services in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a navigation issue on the pricing page for deployment services, ensuring users are correctly guided to create a deployment before subscribing. The button behavior has been adjusted to prevent users from being directed to the universal balance, which does not support the subscription packages. Additionally, a login issue related to the new deployment creation has been resolved, enhancing the overall user experience.

items.title: Enhance Button Spacing for Icons and Text in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses the spacing issue between icons and text in several buttons on the Email Marketing page. A total of 15 buttons have been modified to include appropriate margins, ensuring a consistent and visually appealing layout. Additionally, a new script has been introduced to check button icon spacing across the project, enhancing code quality and maintainability.

items.title: Fix chat blockquote spacing issue in Nexior 🎨
items.summary: This update addresses a spacing issue with markdown blockquotes in the chat feature. The margin and padding for blockquotes were overridden by lazy-loaded CSS from github-markdown-css, causing visual inconsistencies. The fix restores the intended spacing, ensuring a more cohesive appearance in chat messages.

items.title: Revamped Conversation Actions Menu in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: The conversation actions menu has been relocated to the right of the model selector, resolving previous overlap issues with the Credits capsule. This update introduces a new component for conversation actions, consolidating rename, share, and delete functionalities while enhancing internationalization support across multiple languages. The layout has also been improved for better responsiveness on various devices.

items.title: Update aichat2 CLI Examples to Match Latest Docs in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update aligns the aichat2 CLI examples with the latest documentation schema, specifically addressing changes in the request shape for paused tool resumption and unattended policy payloads. Key modifications include updated help text for CLI commands and refreshed test coverage to ensure accuracy with the current OpenAPI contract.

items.title: Remove Unused System Prompt from Scheduled Tasks in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the `system_prompt` field from the scheduled tasks pipeline, which was never utilized in the UI or documentation. Key changes include modifications to the `scheduledTasksHandler`, `scheduledTriggerHandler`, and `scheduledTasks` files to eliminate references to this field. The removal streamlines the codebase and clarifies the intended functionality moving forward.

items.title: Confirmed AiChat Alignment with Docs in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update verifies that the AiChat MCP server is already aligned with the latest documentation following a recent sync. Key endpoints, request parameters, and model enums were checked, confirming no changes were necessary. This no-op sync serves to document that AiChat is current with the OpenAPI source of truth.

items.title: Update AI Chat Scheduled Tasks Documentation in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update clarifies the behavior of scheduled tasks in the AI chat system, specifically regarding the handling of user prompts. The documentation now accurately reflects that tasks will not automatically skip steps when user input is required, but will instead halt and be marked as failed. Users are provided with actionable advice to avoid such situations by ensuring prompts are clear and complete.

items.title: Remove misleading tools_filter_exclude for clarity in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the unused `tools_filter_exclude` field from the `runChatInBackground` function, which was never read in the codebase. The change eliminates confusion caused by incorrect documentation while ensuring no runtime behavior is altered. This cleanup enhances code clarity and maintains accurate user documentation.

items.title: Enhance WeChat Login Experience in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the WeChat login card on the deployment management page by changing the display message for unrecognized windows. Instead of directing users to the Windows Viewer, it now shows a loading message and provides clear instructions for users. Additionally, redundant status tags have been removed to streamline the user interface.

items.title: Enhance Scheduled Tasks with Task ID Display and Copy Feature in Nexior ✨
items.summary: This update introduces a new feature that displays the task ID below the task name in the scheduled tasks list. Users can now click the ID to copy it to the clipboard, streamlining the process of troubleshooting and API interactions. The implementation includes updates to the UI and tests to ensure functionality and prevent unintended interactions.

items.title: Enhance Invoice Alignment and Badge Colors in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update improves the alignment of invoice lines with order fields by switching to a flex layout, ensuring consistent spacing. The badge color has been changed to a lighter effect for better visibility, and the hover behavior has been refined to eliminate any jitter. Additionally, a redundant download button has been removed to streamline the user interface.

items.title: Fix Discord Polling and WeChat Card Styles in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update addresses two critical issues: the infinite polling for degraded Discord deployments and missing styles in the WeChat login panel. A new timeout mechanism has been implemented to prevent endless polling, while the WeChat component now correctly defines its card title styles, ensuring consistency across the UI. Additionally, an automated script has been added to check for style compliance in deployment components.

items.title: Fix workload label for appliance tenants in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue where the workload label for appliance tenants was incorrectly derived from the service alias, leading to potential scheduling conflicts with tenant VMs. A new stable, product-independent label has been introduced to ensure proper pod anti-affinity and prevent silent failures during deployments. Comprehensive tests have been added to validate the changes and ensure reliability.

items.title: Prevent Default Account Override on New Connections in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves an issue where binding a new account would unintentionally replace the user's default account. The `set_default_connection()` function now includes a parameter to prevent overriding an existing default account. Additionally, new tests have been added to ensure the functionality works as intended, confirming that existing defaults remain intact when new accounts are connected.

items.title: Enhance builder affinity with stable workload labels in Wisdom 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the builder's pod affinity settings to prioritize the new stable workload label, `acedatacloud/workload=appliance`. It ensures that fresh installations do not compete for disk I/O with existing QEMU VMs, improving deployment efficiency. The change is compatible with existing setups and will allow for a smoother transition as tenants are updated.

items.title: Enhance Audience Segmentation and Token Management in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new audience segmentation design document, breaking down dormant users into 12 operational groups. Additionally, a new script for managing Threads OAuth tokens has been added, ensuring secure token exchanges without hardcoding secrets. The .gitignore file has also been updated to clean up untracked directories from retired repositories.

items.title: Fix subscription package display on pricing page in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves an issue where subscription packages were not displaying correctly on the pricing page. The filtering logic for service prices has been adjusted to accommodate period-based subscriptions, ensuring all relevant packages are shown. Additionally, localization improvements were made for package names across multiple languages.

items.title: Unify Pricing Structure and Clean Up Legacy Data in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update consolidates the pricing structure by making JSON the sole source of service costs, eliminating outdated preset display prices. Key changes include modifications to the `sync.py` script for better package management and the introduction of new tests to ensure compatibility and correctness. The impact is a streamlined pricing process that reduces the need for manual migrations and enhances clarity in pricing data.

items.title: Improve Error Handling for WeChat Instance Connectivity in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue where users were misled by a persistent loading state when the WeChat instance was unreachable. The error handling now distinguishes between temporary connectivity issues and complete unreachability, providing users with clearer feedback and actionable next steps. Additionally, internationalization support has been enhanced across multiple languages.

items.title: Fix tenant domain routing for appliance in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves an issue where the newly deployed wechat-bot instances were unreachable due to incorrect DNS routing. The ingress domain is now correctly set to point to the Azure AKS cluster, ensuring that requests are routed properly. Additionally, new tests have been added to validate this change and prevent future regressions.

items.title: Refactor product panels for better service registration in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update refactors the management page by creating a dedicated `WindowsViewerCard` component and aligning the product panel display logic across different pages. It introduces a new `managePanels.ts` file to standardize the criteria for displaying product panels, ensuring consistency and reducing code complexity. The overall code size in `Manage.vue` has been reduced by 33%, improving maintainability.

items.title: Fix endpoint bugs for better command handling in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses three critical bugs found in the command endpoints of the Discord bot. The new `sweep_all.py` tool now tests all 27 endpoints, revealing issues such as incorrect routing for `/producer videos`, parameter validation failures for `/suno vox`, and incorrect artifact handling for `/suno lyrics` and `/suno style`. These fixes enhance the reliability and user experience of the bot's command functionality.

items.title: Fix session cursor issues for seamless reconnections in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses three critical issues related to session cursor management in the coding bridge. Key changes include preventing the replay of the entire buffer on session re-keying, ensuring that closed sessions do not lose their cursors, and properly clearing validation markers on stream truncation. These fixes enhance the reliability of session handling and improve overall user experience.

items.title: Fix session handling to prevent browser silence in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the `drop()` function to clear events while preserving the sequence counter for closed sessions. This change ensures that clients with stale cursors receive proper notifications instead of being silently ignored. Additionally, new tests have been added to validate these behaviors, ensuring robust functionality.

items.title: Enhance Campaign Delivery Status Display in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new `DeliveryRecipientTable` component that accurately reflects the delivery status of recipients for frozen campaigns. It replaces the previous candidate list with real-time delivery states, allowing operators to see who has been delivered, bounced, or failed, along with error details. Additionally, the implementation includes improved internationalization support across multiple languages.

items.title: Enhance i18n Process with Repair Step in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update corrects the i18n documentation to include a crucial `--repair` step after backfilling translations. The changes in `AGENTS.md` and `.claude/commands/i18n-backfill.md` clarify the process and prevent English placeholders from persisting. This ensures that the CI checks will effectively catch translation issues moving forward.

items.title: Fix English Placeholders and Enhance Access Control in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses the issue of English placeholders remaining in 16 non-English locales by implementing a retranslation process. Key changes include the enhancement of the translation and coverage checking scripts, ensuring that untranslated keys are flagged correctly. Additionally, a whitelist for acceptable English terms has been introduced, significantly improving the localization quality across the platform.

items.title: Fix translation issues and enhance access control in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses critical translation problems across multiple locales, eliminating over 6,900 instances of English placeholders in non-English locales. Key improvements include a new repair option in the translation script and enhanced checks to prevent English placeholders from reappearing. Additionally, a whitelist for certain English terms ensures accurate localization while maintaining brand integrity.

items.title: Fix English Placeholders and Enhance Access Control in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses the issue of 2,485 English placeholders appearing in non-English locales due to a deadlock in translation tools. Key changes include a new repair option in the translation script, enhanced checks for English placeholders, and the introduction of a whitelist for acceptable English terms. These improvements ensure better localization and prevent regression in translations.

items.title: Documenting Hardening Plan Outcomes in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update documents the successful implementation of the hardening plan, which involved merging a total of 21 pull requests across three layers. Key changes include adjustments to version storage and the integration of testing protocols to enhance security. The documentation now reflects these changes, ensuring clarity on the implementation process and outcomes.

items.title: Implement schema parity test for browser-relay in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a cross-repo contract test that compares the frame models of browser-relay against the JSON Schema defined in the PlatformFrontend repository. The test aims to catch any discrepancies between the two definitions, ensuring that silent drift does not occur. Additionally, modifications to the CI workflow ensure that the schema is fetched correctly, preventing false positives in test results.

items.title: Fix protocol schema discrepancies for better relay compatibility in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update corrects two key fields in the browser protocol schema to align with the relay's requirements. The 'execution_sequence' minimum was adjusted from 0 to 1, and a description was added to clarify the handling of 'device_id' and 'connection_epoch'. These changes enhance the schema's accuracy and prevent potential validation failures.
